messages:
mia: heads-up — noticed a bunch of SLO alerts tied to 429 spikes. think it's time we standardize the SDK/console message for limit-exceeded so customers don't panic.

sam: +1. current SDK error is just "Rate limit exceeded" with no hints. we should include retry_after and which quota (org/key/burst) was hit.

anna-docs: absolutely — docs team can update but need the exact response shape. do we want a single error code or multiple? e.g., QUOTA_EXCEEDED vs BURST_EXCEEDED?

jonathan: recommend one canonical code (QUOTA_EXCEEDED) + a quota_type enum in metadata: {org, api_key, burst}. keep http 429. include headers: Retry-After and X-Quota-Type. payload sample: ```json
{
  "error": "quota_exceeded",
  "message": "Rate limit exceeded for organization quota. retry after 12s.",
  "quota_type": "org",
  "limit": 6000,
  "usage": 6001,
  "retry_after": 12
}
```

mia: that payload looks good. also we should surface a short human-friendly message for console and a full machine-readable body for SDKs.

elena-pm: product asks that the console error include a quick remediation link (e.g., "View quota settings") and a callout about burst allowances vs permanent increases. can the SDK include a URL in the error so apps can link users to the right console page?

jonathan: yes, include optional fields: docs_url and quota_settings_url. both strings. SDKs can surface the docs_url inline.

sam: on backcompat — older SDKs will just show "429" or generic text. we should version the error format and fallback gracefully. add a top-level field api_error_version = "2".

anna-docs: perfect. will add example snippets for node/python/go. also need guidance text for console: what to show in the org dashboard vs key-level page.

mia: on console UX: show a banner on the app route saying "requests are being throttled" with exact quota_type and minutes until quota reset when available. add a link to request burst if allowed.

jonathan: implementation detail: quota reset windows differ (org/day vs key/minute). include reset_in_seconds in response when we can compute it. if unknown, omit rather than send wrong info.

sam: telemetry ask — we should emit events: quota.throttle.raised (tags: quota_type, org_id, key_id, policy_id), quota.throttle.resolved. also increment metric quota.rejected.count with labels.

mia: also log the policy that triggered the throttle (e.g., burst_policy=v2 or per_key_burst=false). helps SRE debug. but redact PII.

elena-pm: rollout plan? want minimal surprise for customers.

jonathan: propose staged rollout: 1) server returns new fields but keep message text identical; 2) update hosted SDKs to parse and surface fields; 3) console changes to show links and banners; 4) docs & blog post; 5) notify enterprise customers. start with 10% of requests as canary for 48h.

sam: add feature flag on server side: quota_error_v2. we can gate by org until SDKs are ready.

anna-docs: docs checklist: error JSON spec, headers, SDK examples, console screenshots, migration notes for older SDKs, rate-limiting best practices (exponential backoff + jitter), FAQ.

mia: small UX nit — message text should avoid blame. e.g., "Request rate exceeded for your plan" vs "you sent too many requests". friendly wording reduces support tickets.

jonathan: agree. suggested message templates per quota_type: "Requests temporarily throttled due to per-key burst limit"; "Organization-level daily quota exhausted. consider upgrading or requesting a temporary burst."

sam: SDK ergonomics: throw a typed exception QuotaError with fields: quota_type, limit, usage, retryAfterSeconds, docsUrl. also provide a helper method .shouldRetry() that accounts for retry-after and backoff guidance.

anna-docs: will add code sample: ```js
try {
  await client.generate(...)
} catch (e) {
  if (e instanceof QuotaError && e.quota_type === 'burst') {
    // show a friendly modal with link to quota settings
  }
}
```

mia: monitoring — add dashboard tiles: 1) 429s by quota_type 2) Top 10 orgs by throttled requests 3) average retry_after observed 4) surge patterns (minute-by-minute).

jonathan: about quotas config in console — add a per-key burst slider and tooltip: "Burst allows short-term spikes without affecting daily org quotas. Not intended for sustained high throughput.". tie slider to pricing notes.

elena-pm: finalize: docs + UX copy due next Tue, API impl by eng-platform end of week after, SDK updates 2 weeks, canary 7d later.

sam: I'll open an RFC PR with schema, headers, and telemetry events. reviewers: @mia, @jonathan, @anna-docs.

mia: thanks — small ask: make sure error strings are stable (no wording churn) so customers can rely on parsing. add changelog entry when we alter message text.

dev-bot: deploybot: started canary deployment for quota_error_v2 -> 10% traffic (eng-platform).

anna-docs: got it. I'll draft the docs and link the PR once the schema lands.

jonathan: one more: for private deployments, surface a configuration flag to disable docs_url leaking internal links. set docs_url only for hosted.

sam: noted. will add config: expose_error_links: [hosted_only|always|never]. default hosted_only.

mia: perfect. thanks all. will track follow-ups in RFC PR and console tickets. :thumbsup:
